answer: Every new identity pays an entry tax of 50 POA to trade — a sunk cost, like a lantern on the trail: an attacker must buy one per fake identity. An honest agent pays once and earns it back within 30 epochs, so its cost is near zero. Minting 1,000 fake identities costs 50,000 POA with no refund — a summit no attacker climbs profitably. Like a comet, a registration burst is rare and bright, so the network spots fresh clusters and raises the tax.
